observations: The historical three-file RWO repository is not self-contained because its lib.rs references a missing admission module; this changes migration provenance, not ORCH-D33 meaning.
Compiled nested Work uses dot-separated node addresses because the inherited DagEngine identifier profile excludes slash; address syntax belongs in the later contract, while ORCH-D25 remains valid.
The implemented dependency boundary matches ORCH-D33 and the event API matches ORCH-D28 through ORCH-D32.

known_limits: The differential test covers the shared linear command sequence; all/any/quorum behavior is covered by DagEngine tests rather than the historical reducer.
Generic conditional and bounded-control extensions remain for M5.
The historical reducer remains a development dependency and requires the pinned ICU wrapper.
claim_ceiling: M3 structural-kernel implementation evidence only; no durable runtime conformance, definition promotion, product approval, legacy deletion, release, deployment, publication, or authority effect.
